Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate vs In Re: Abu Taher Khan &
Anr on 7 October, 2024

Author: Soumen Sen
Bench: Soumen Sen
 07.10.2024
 Court No.29
 Item No. 27
 Allowed
 sg
 Crm (A) 3579 of 2024
 In Re:- An application for anticipatory bail under Secti
 Criminal Procedure read with Section 482 of Bhartiya Nag
 in connection with Ghatal Police Station Case No. 195 of
 under Section 406/420/506//34 of Indian Penal Code, pend

Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Ghatal, Paschim Me
 And
 In Re: Abu Taher Khan & Anr.

Petitioners
 Mr. Sarwar Jahan
 Mr. Sayantan Hazra
 For the Petitioner
 Mr. Saibal Bapuli
 Mr. Raju Mondla
We have heard the learned Counsel for the parties.
2. Apparently, there are disputes with regard to management of a teaching training institute.

Earlier,
there was a complaint which was similar in nature and in connection thereof, a coordinate Bench granted anticipatory bail to the petitioner no.1 on 7th November, 2022 in CRM(A) 4723 of 2022.
3. Considering the materials available in the case diary it appears that the disputes are essentially civil in nature and both sides claimed control over the institute.

This appears to be a continuation of the first FIR and there has been no substantial change in circumstances excepting continuance of and exchange of verbal between the parties and both have made allegations against each other.

The petitioner no.2 is the wife of the petitioner no.1 and the allegation against the petitioner no.2 is Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate vs In Re: Abu Taher Khan & Anr on 7 October, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/175603022/
1 general and omnibus in nature.

entities.text: Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate vs In Re: Abu Taher Khan & Anr on 7 October, 2024 Indian Kanoon
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The principal allegation is against the petitioner no.1.

Signed By :
SANJIB GHOSH High Court of Calcutta 8 th of October 2024 04:04:04 PM 4.
In the background of the aforesaid facts, we are of the view that the custodial interrogation of the present petitioners is not necessary.

5. Accordingly, we direct that in the event of arrest, the present petitioners, namely, Abu Taher Khan and Moriyan Bibi, shall be released on bail upon furnishing a bond of Rs.10,000/- each, with two sureties of like amount each, one of whom must be local, to the satisfaction of the Arresting Officer and also subject to the conditions as laid down under Section 438(2) of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 corresponding to Section 482(2) of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita and on further condition that the petitioner no.1 shall meet the Investigating Officer once in a fortnight till the submission of the final report and the petitioner no.2 shall cooperate with the investigation.
The petitioners shall appear before the jurisdictional court within two weeks from date.
6. Accordingly, the prayer for anticipatory bail of the petitioners is allowed.
7. All parties shall act on the server copies of this order duly downloaded from the official website of this Court.

(Soumen Sen, J.) (Uday Kumar, J.)
